newsitem.title: USA: Griffin-Spalding County, Ga., referendum cleared.
newsitem.headline: Griffin-Spalding County, Ga., referendum cleared.

text.p: Federal officials have cleared the way for a March 18 referendum on a proposal to consolidate the governments of Georgia's Spalding County and the city of Griffin, the Griffin Daily News reported Tuesday.
U.S. Justice Department approved the districting plan for the proposed unified government, finding that it did not dilute the voting strength of minorities.
Charter Commission Vice Chairman Earle Childres said consolidation would eventually save taxpayers money, although the savings may take a few years to materialize.
Griffin has about 22,000 residents and is the county seat for Spalding County, which has about 60,000 residents.
